items.summary: NIKE (NYSE:NKE) used its 46th annual shareholder meeting to outline progress in its business reset, emphasizing a sport-focused operating model, growth in performance categories and efforts to improve its marketplace execution. items.title: Strategy just dropped $250 'Bitcoin' Jordans with one big catch
items.summary: The company holding 845,050 Bitcoin just sold out a limited sneaker drop. It only took cash.

items.title: Lululemon's New CEO Inherits a 52% Stock Collapse
items.summary: Heidi O'Neill takes over after a brutal year for Lululemon, with weak sales, tariff pressure and competition all weighing on the business.

items.title: Job One for Lululemon’s New CEO: Yoga With Employees
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica’s new chief executive immersed herself in the company’s culture on day one by taking a yoga class with employees at the company’s Vancouver, British Columbia headquarters. Heidi O’Neill also said in a blog post Tuesday that she plans to hold a fireside chat with employees later this week where she will share more about her background and answer questions.

items.title: Nike’s Elliott Hill Aims to Squash Scepticism Over Turnaround Strategy
items.summary: At Tuesday's annual shareholders' meeting, CEO Elliott Hill said progress won't "be a straight line" and the team is building "for the next decade."

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Intel, Amgen, Qualcomm, Rigetti
items.summary: ↘️ Amgen (AMGN): Shares of the biotechnology company, a major contributor to the Dow, shed 10%, its sharpest drop in 25 years. The move came after the Swiss drugmaker Novartis (CH:NOVN) said late Friday that an experimental medicine failed to reduce cardiovascular risk in a late-stage clinical trial.

items.title: Nike exits the S&P 100 after 18 years and a $200 billion market-cap wipeout
items.summary: The sportswear giant will be replaced by a tech company on Sept. 21, capping a five-year, nearly 80% stock slide driven by China weakness.
